products.name: Kore.ai
products.note: Enterprise agentic AI platform; multi-agent orchestration; comprehensive governance dashboard with audit logs, RBAC, and guardrails; 400+ Fortune 2000 customers

reading.body:
Kore.ai raised $50.8 million across two Form D filings in 2021, the only hard financial data held on the company.

The two filings are sequential, not a single round split for paperwork. The April filing reported $30.8 million sold against a $50.8 million offering, and the September filing reported $20.0 million sold against a $23.5 million offering. Together they describe roughly $50.8 million raised in about six months, with first sales on March 31 and September 10, 2021. That is the entire capital picture the data supports.

What the company sells is an enterprise agentic AI platform: multi-agent orchestration plus a governance layer of audit logs, role-based access control, and guardrails, aimed at customer service and employee productivity across banking, healthcare, retail, telco, and travel. It reports 400+ Fortune 2000 customers. That customer count is the more consequential number here, because it places agentic AI inside large existing enterprises rather than in new AI-native ones.

The data does not connect this company to compute, buildings, or power in any way. There is no disclosed inference footprint, no data center or cloud commitment, no energy figure. It also carries no valuation, no revenue, no headcount, and no litigation record, and the Form D amounts are gross offering figures rather than net proceeds. The 2021 filing dates mean the capital predates the current agentic deployment wave, so they say little about how the company is funded today.

profile_text.body:
Kore.ai is an enterprise AI company whose website describes it as a leader in enterprise AI that helps businesses accelerate outcomes across customer service and employee productivity with agentic AI. The site lists the industries it serves as banking, wealth management, healthcare for payers, providers and life sciences, retail, telco, and travel and hospitality.

Its tracked product is an enterprise agentic AI platform of the same name, offering multi-agent orchestration and a governance dashboard with audit logs, role-based access control, and guardrails. The company reports 400+ Fortune 2000 customers. No litigation or MCP server records are held for it.
